scope: SodaDEX trade and integrated 1952 mining frontend presentation

design.direction: 清晰、紧凑、轻盈；沿用紫红品牌色、默认浅色和深色主题
design.trade: 桌面左行情右订单，手机优先展示订单；兑换和限价标签置于同一表单顶部
design.mining: 四种任务收敛为一个当前表单，桌面侧栏、手机两列任务选择；余额、滑点和结算工具按需展开

local: narrow mobile trade and limit modes
simulated approve and swap success then history
keyboard access to expanded settlement tools
browser.isolation: Mining action evidence uses tests/browser/mining-visual.html with mocked RPC and a dedicated simulated provider. No extension discovery, remote service writes or chain broadcast.
browser.limits: Local 5174 market/API reads remained pending; existing public frontend was independently observed showing actual pool price and two swap records. This UI pass does not repeat prior real-wallet chain acceptance.

correctedDuringReview: segmented buttons must not submit the form
freeze navigation while preparing a quote
scope absolute header positioning to order tabs
remove nested limit card and pad order history

visualReview.scale: 1 broken, 3 competent, 4 strong, 5 exceptional; subjective self-review, not a competitor benchmark

taskClarity.evidence: One active mining form and one primary action replace four equal-weight forms.

composition.evidence: Market and order columns align; mining task rail shares the form baseline.

typography.evidence: Amount and price numbers lead, metadata and secondary controls are subordinate.

density.evidence: Settings, balances and settlement tools expand only when needed.

surfaces.evidence: Shared light/dark tokens and magenta selection; nested limit surface removed.

states.evidence: Disabled/read failure, paused claims, simulated success and keyboard disclosure states inspected.

responsive.evidence: Mobile uses order-first stacking and a two-column mining task selector without page overflow.

distinctiveness.evidence: Consistent SodaDEX accent and task layout, with intentionally familiar DEX controls.
